scope: Publicly observable ESXi DirectPath behavior in an authorized nested lab; no private implementation inference

passthruCapability.qemuVersion: All 23 capability cases recorded QEMU 6.2.0; system and instrumented 6.2.0 builds were used across submatrices

observedModel.rootComplexEndpoint: FLR produced Function reset and capable=true; PM-only and tested D3hot advertisements remained Reset=None/capable=false
observedModel.bridgeEndpoint: An upstream reset boundary produced Bridge reset/capable=true even when the endpoint lacked FLR and PM
observedModel.acs: No-ACS was capable under the observed bypass policy; strict root-port ACS checking made the same endpoint incapable; the documented global disableACSCheck workaround restored capability even while the strict root-port option remained enabled
observedModel.identity: Capability flipped while VID:DID stayed fixed, so a VID:DID-only model is disproven for these cases

classAndBridgeRole.classCodeVerdict: pass: 0200/0500/0b02/0b40/0600/0604 Type-0 FLR variants were all capable with Function reset
classAndBridgeRole.type1BridgeVerdict: pass: a native-FLR X3130 Type-1 bridge reported Function reset but remained incapable
classAndBridgeRole.conclusion: Class code is not a blanket gate; an assignable-payload or structural-fabric-role gate is independent of accepted reset capability

acsCheckBypass.conclusion: disableACSCheck=TRUE bypassed ACS admission with enableACSCheckForRP=TRUE; this changed capability policy, not the emulated hardware ACS surface

sharedRootPort.result: AH Failed to find a suitable device before BAR/IOMMU mapping

dedicatedRootPort.result: Only 0000:02:00.0 changed owner; the VM then mapped and booted
dedicatedRootPort.conclusion: Static capability and owner state are necessary but not sufficient; the whole reset/IOMMU dependency must be exclusively assignable

largeBarRuntime.endpoint: QEMU pci-testdev 1b36:0005 with no equal-size backing allocation

bar32GiB.runnerNote: The final v14 case hit the ESXi display-name length limit; v15 reran it after stable hash truncation and passed the expected negative assertion

checksRequiredForGuestPass: outer QEMU argv and HMP report the requested physical BAR

reset.observed: Root-complex virtio endpoint with FLR was capable with Reset Method=Function reset; outer qdev reset callbacks were recorded on VM power-on and power-off
reset.boundary: This does not prove electrical SBR/D3 behavior or sensitive-state clearing on a physical vendor device

dmaLifecycle.observedModel: Power-off invalidated the guest translation and rebound the requester from guest domain 2 to the ESXi host identity domain 1; teardown did not produce a DMAR fault

aer.summary: In the historical e1000e profile, Correctable and Non-Fatal status bodies remained raw-readable while the guest AER header was hidden; no matching host or guest AER log event was observed in the captured windows

pme.summary: Default, explicit 0x1f, and deny-PME 0x1b _OSC masks matched requested ownership; endpoint/root PME status was injected and guest-readable without a native PME IRQ, matching the tested KB ignored-PME model

p2p.summary: Default and relaxACSforP2P-only were rejected by an IOMMU fault; allowP2P=true allowed peer DMA with or without relaxACSforP2P in the non-strict matrices

rmrr.summary: ESXi recognized the endpoint RMRR, automatically adjusted the PCI hole and booted when non-overlapping; an RMRR overlapping low System RAM prevented ESXi from becoming host-ready

optionRom.classification: entry-not-observed after pcipSaveOPROM=TRUE and pciPassthru0.opromEnabled=TRUE; this is a tested negative for the selected build/endpoint, not an unexecuted case

observed: Raw SR-IOV extended capability and VFE/ARI state can be constructed
ESXi exposes functional Total/Initial VFs as zero or omits the raw VF
QEMU igb with I350 identity reaches the ESXi igbn driver but fails public initialization with Invalid NVM Checksum
sriov.unlock: Use an ESXi-supported physical PF or a substantially fuller PF/NVM/firmware device model

remainingRealHardware: SR-IOV functional PF/VF assignment and VF reset
